blocks.text: VALENCIA CITY, Bukidnon — Bukidnon police arrested six individuals and seized 25.544 grams of suspected shabu worth P177,356 in anti-illegal drug operations on Friday and Saturday. In Valencia City, operatives arrested a 26-year-old male suspect known as “Jojo” at Purok 18, Poblacion, at 2:02 p.m. on Oct. 10. Seized from him were four heat-sealed plastic sachets containing 6.2 grams of suspected shabu worth P42,160. In Libona, joint operatives arrested an 18-year-old male suspect known as “Eking” at Purok 1A, Barangay Poblacion, at 1:33 a.m. on Oct. 10.
